purpose: Normalize safety flags used by formula records so AcuTing OS can later connect formulas to medications, pregnancy/fertility workflows, red flags, and SOAP note checks.
public_rule: Safety flags are screening prompts, not medical advice. Any public content must use conservative wording and cite professional sources.

flags.meaning: Requires professional review before use during pregnancy, suspected pregnancy, or fertility treatment cycles.
Potentially inappropriate in pregnancy unless specifically supervised by a qualified clinician.
Review timing and safety with IUI/IVF medications such as gonadotropins, ovulation triggers, progesterone, estrogen, or anticoagulant protocols.
Review if the patient uses anticoagulants, antiplatelets, has bleeding disorders, heavy bleeding, or surgery/procedure timing.
Requires assessment of abnormal bleeding, heavy menses, pregnancy bleeding, anemia, or urgent referral red flags.
Review cardiovascular history, stimulant-like herbs, blood pressure, palpitations, and related medications.
Review palpitations, arrhythmia, chest pain, cardiac diagnosis, and medication interactions.
Review use of sedatives, sleep medications, psychiatric medications, alcohol, and drowsiness risk.
Screen for suicidal ideation, mania, psychosis, severe anxiety, severe insomnia, or urgent safety needs.
Screen for shortness of breath, chest pain, high fever, low oxygen, severe asthma, pneumonia concerns, or urgent symptoms.
Screen for severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, blood in stool, dehydration, weight loss, or urgent symptoms.
Review kidney disease history, edema, urinary symptoms, kidney labs when available, and medication interactions.
Review liver disease, hepatitis history, abnormal liver enzymes, alcohol use, hepatotoxic medications, and herb safety.
Review bloating, nausea, poor appetite, loose stools, dampness, or digestive weakness when using rich tonics.
Formula category requires professional supervision or modern medical diagnosis before use.
